description: A Discord moderation bot. Jev classifies each incoming message as legitimate, spam or a scam link, and the bot deletes flagged messages and escalates from warnings to timeouts. A /profile command scores a member's recent messages for scam risk, spam, toxicity and helpfulness.
how_used_jev: Each message goes to Jev with the sender's account age, whether it has a link, and messages admins have pardoned before. One pick-one question sorts it into legitimate, spam or scam link, and a yes/no question asks whether it needs an immediate ban. Confidence thresholds split flags into a high and a medium tier. A pardoned false flag is saved and passed to Jev as a known-safe example on that server's later checks, so it adapts without retraining.
author: @brainstormity

recipe.install: git clone https://github.com/brainstormity/Jev-Moderation-Bot && cd Jev-Moderation-Bot && pip install -r requirements.txt
